decisive_items: Potentially revertant area epidermis: High rates of wild-type transcripts (35.0%)
A patch of healthy skin (7.5 × 4 cm²) on the left forearm, lacking blistering
Affected skin epidermis: Dominant RNA transcripts with premature stop codons, wild-type reads rare (1.1%)
response.rationale: R1 is more specific and directly supported by the high wild-type transcript rate in the revertant epidermis and the healthy skin patch, indicating revertant mosaicism. R3 captures the underlying disease but omits the key revertant mosaicism finding.
